decisions_required_before_dispatch.question: How should the original X leads (104 facing right / 136 facing left, authored for a 256 px window) be mapped onto the 348 px view?

options.name: CENTER-relative
options.rule: target screen X = viewW/2 - 24 (right-facing) or viewW/2 + 8 (left-facing); zone +/-8
options.effect: keeps the original offset from the view centre: 150/182 at 348 px; visible space ahead grows by 46 px in both directions

options.name: EDGE-relative
options.rule: target screen X = 104 / 136 from the left edge
options.effect: all extra width appears to the right: look-ahead right-facing 244 px, left-facing 212 px behind

options.name: keep GameMaker native horizontal follow
options.effect: retains the current lack of facing lead; only vertical changes

decisions_required_before_dispatch.recommendation: D1-A: it reuses the existing CENTER(n) category of the accepted viewport adapter and treats the change as a documented adapter. ROM does not say which was intended (docs/viewport-semantics-audit.md: unresolved).

decisions_required_before_dispatch.question: Should the GM view top be the canonical camera (status quo) or canonical camera + 17 (the ROM's R9 bias)?

options.name: status quo
options.rule: view top = canonical camera; follow model runs in canonical camera space
options.effect: Sonic's foot sits at screen line 80+17..112+17 = 97..129 instead of 80..112 (17 px low); minimal blast radius

options.name: view = canonical + 17
options.rule: all canonical consumers read camera = view - 17
options.effect: exact framing; touches 79 view-Y reads in 64 files and 55 chaos_vp_current() calls

decisions_required_before_dispatch.recommendation: D2-A for C1-I; revisit B only as a separate, fully regression-tested package.

decisions_required_before_dispatch.question: View height 196 vs 192

options.name: extra 4 rows at the bottom
options.rule: zone is measured from the view top; 'vertical is not widened'

decisions_required_before_dispatch.recommendation: D3-A (only one option compatible with the existing viewport policy).

decisions_required_before_dispatch.question: Mapped-object X policy (+1 px terrain-space bias): sign only, class-wide, or none?

options.name: class-wide +1 with a Windows comparison round
options.effect: possible 1 px right shift of all mapped objects

decisions_required_before_dispatch.recommendation: D4-A for C1-I; raise B as a separate cross-class question.

items.title: ROM follow camera (X and Y) replacing GameMaker's native follow in ordinary acts
items.size: moderate (one new script, one Step_2 branch; no collision or movement change)
rom_requirement: tools/c1r_camera_model.py is the executable contract: leads (X `$68/$88`, Y `$60`) slew 1 px/update, zones +/-8 (X) and +/-16 (Y), step cap 7, low-byte compare, dropped crossing steps at limits (left/top inclusive, right/bottom exclusive), pan mode skips everything.
Initial Y lead `$78` at level load, X lead initial `$78`.
poc_integration_points: objects/OBJ_chaos_zone/Step_2.gml:13-20 (replace the rigid End Step lock and the GM object follow)
scripts/SCR_player_view/SCR_player_view.gml (switch the view object off for ordinary acts)
items.modification_scope: 1 new script (chaos_camera_follow), edits to 3 existing files; MGHZ/AQZ/EEZ special cases (VSpeed=0, +/-7 cap) become redundant for THZ/GPZ/SEZ/MGHZ and are replaced by the same model; special stages untouched.
fixtures: data/c1r/camera-look-trace.json: replay each scenario's player X/Y/facing/lead-target series through the GML port; per-update camera X/Y and both leads must equal the recorded work_x/work_y/lead_x/lead_y exactly (3,557 updates).
acceptance: Windows: standing on flat ground then falling/rising: Sonic rests at the original screen offsets; turning shows the 32-update lead slew; boss arenas, sign pan and special stages unchanged
risks: Camera-dependent systems (lifecycle bands, instance_activate_region, death line `playerY-camY >= $D0`, MGHZ oil plunge, AQZ/EEZ scroll) all read the view; the model must keep view top = canonical camera (decision D2-A)
fast falls: step cap 7 lets Sonic outrun the camera (original behaviour; MGHZ already does this)

items.title: Peel-Out (states $15/$1A) and removal of the look-up jump
items.size: moderate (new core states, no collision change)
rom_requirement: State 3 + fresh button (Sonic only) -> `$46CE`: vx 0, request 21 (`$15`), sound request `$AC`, no jump.
State 21: lead `$60`, terrain pass, side push-out +/-4, `$48BC`, screen clamp, `$AC` re-request on fresh button, release when Up is not held -> `$46E2`.
`$46E2`: max X speed `$0700`, vx = +/-`$0700` (facing bit), request 26 (`$1A`), sound request `$BE`, invulnerable (`D503` bit 7) for 12 updates.
State 26: lead `$60`, shared movement, `$4281`, side contact clears bits 1 and 7 and walks, floor block `$19` -> run, else walk/run exits (`$37F4`).
poc_integration_points: attack-posture code must leave bit 1 untouched
items.modification_scope: about 60 lines in SCR_chaos_core.gml (two states, one interception); presentation already exists; sound ids as requests only.
fixtures: peel_out_ordinary: states 21 from update 22, 26 from update 85, vx 1792 at the release update, friction series, D503 bit 7 for 12 updates
peel_out_hold_right: vx constant 1792 until the ramp at x about 393 (state 27 launch)
acceptance: Fixture series equal (state, vx, move byte) on the same terrain
Windows: Up + jump never jumps; charge, release with Up, run, wall hit, loop entry from 26 (observe only)
risks: state 26 can reach loops/ramps/springs: only the shared handlers are used, but a Windows pass must try them
invulnerability must not enable contact kills (bit 7 only; attack bit untouched)
